name: Cameron Tober
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Chicago, Illinois
education: Loyola University Chicago School of Law
about: Cameron Tober is a dedicated attorney striving to help victims of personal injury cases across the Chicagoland area. Working from his office at Tober Law, LLC, in Chicago, Illinois, he focuses his practice on matters involving construction accidents, products liability, motor vehicle accidents and trucking accidents, among others. Approaching each case with shrewd legal acumen and a deep sense of empathy, he ensures that his clients feel supported and heard throughout the legal process.

Upon graduating from Purdue University Mitch Daniels School of Business with a bachelor’s degree in economics, Mr. Tober enrolled at Loyola University Chicago School of Law to bolster his advocacy skills. He received his Juris Doctor in 2019, and in the same year was admitted to practice law in Illinois. During his time at law school, he interned at the Offices of the U.S. Attorneys, learning the ropes of the judiciary early on.

Mr. Tober additionally clerked for the Homicide Task Force in the Cook County Public Defender’s Office, where he assisted attorneys in representing individuals charged with homicide. He also actively served as a student clinician with the Loyola University Chicago Veterans Clinic, working on behalf of the university’s veteran clients, counseling them in a wide range of family disputes. Today, he brings this extensive experience to effectively represent his clients and obtain them the compensation they need to make a healthy recovery.

In an effort to lessen his clients’ burden, Mr. Tober makes sure he handles all legal obligations, allowing his clients to concentrate entirely on their recuperation. He takes a customized approach to every case, getting to know a client on a personal level and adapting his tactics to suit their particular circumstances. This enables him to accurately assess the situation and strive for his clients’ appropriate recovery.
